name: Result grid resolves with confidence scores
looks: A grid of result tiles sits inside a product window, each tile labelled "generating..."; one by one the tiles resolve from a soft blur into a sharp finished photo, each landing with a small confidence percentage in the corner, while a prompt bar below shows the request that produced them.
build: Each tile is independently timed: a blurred placeholder (`filter: blur(12px)`) cross-fades to the sharp final image over 300-400ms, staggered so tiles resolve in a different order each time, not row by row. The percentage badge counts up to its final value in the same window the blur clears.
sound: A soft whoosh per tile as it sharpens, a light tick as each percentage settles.
prompt: Fill a grid of result tiles inside a product window, each starting as a soft blur labelled as still working, then resolve each one to a sharp finished image on its own independent timing with a small confidence score counting up in its corner, so the grid never clears in a predictable row-by-row order.
